title: No charges for Steelers' Metcalf over fan incident...

sources.name: ESPN NFL
sources.title: No charges for Steelers' Metcalf over fan incident...
sources.description: Steelers wide receiver DK Metcalf will not face criminal charges stemming from his altercation with a fan at Ford Field during the Steelers' December game against the Detroit Lions, the Wayne County Prosecutors Office announced May 1.
